answer.reason: In the EIA Kansas Electricity Profile 2024 edition, Table 1 reports net generation for the most recent year (2023) alongside the prior year (2022). For the IPP & CHP row, the 2023 figure is 30,081,305 megawatthours, which matches option A; the 27,614,850 megawatthours figure (option B) corresponds to the prior-year (2022) column. This is consistent with Kansas generation data, where IPP & CHP is dominated by independent wind generation (roughly 30 TWh in 2023).
